bounded_host_request.command: docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT count(*) AS rooms, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.announcement_id IS NULL) AS missing_announcement, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status='draft') AS announcement_draft, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status='published') AS announcement_published FROM room_posts r LEFT JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.updated_at>=now()-interval '48 hours'" && docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT coalesce(d.status,'no_delivery') AS delivery_status,count(*) FROM room_posts r JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.room_id=r.room_id LEFT JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.source_type='announcement' AND d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text WHERE r.updated_at>=now()-interval '48 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"
